exposure: retrospective locked comparisons on previously examined LIMORE, LICOB, Wong, Yang

two_dimensional.query: 50 independent adult LIMORE HCC lines, 68 stereo exact parent compounds, Activity Area
two_dimensional.metrics: Native positive orientation. Mean drug-wise Spearman and Pearson. Within-lineage rank-gain NDCG@5, expected tie-corrected Precision@5, and Spearman. Any mathematically undefined prediction-constant drug correlation has conventional value zero in paired comparisons only.
two_dimensional.bootstrap: 2400 paired resamples from both independent lineage and compound axes, with re-ranking and re-estimation on each sample. 95% percentile intervals.
two_dimensional.refit: Estimate every base model anew from the corrected table. Pairwise members reuse historical fixed per-drug architectures and amplitudes. Meta-parameters use corrected inner OOF predictions, with a full 65,678-row base refit for each external member. Historical group IDs only preserve the original fold-settings association.
two_dimensional.shuffle: 100 seeded random derangements of LIMORE lineages. Move frozen scGPT and Geneformer representations with the matched raw RNA. Mean RNA and train-mean embeddings are estimated from source only. Models with separable cell effects retain their same rankings across profiles.
two_dimensional.joint_gate: Require positive paired lower 95% limits over drug_mean and additive on LIMORE NDCG@5 and within-drug Spearman, positive lower residual Spearman limit and more than one Top-5 set. Also require positive OOF point gains over drug_mean and additive for both co-primary endpoints. Use mean OOF gain on the two axes over additive to order eligible candidates. If no model meets the joint gate, use structured only as a sensitivity reference when both sensitivity lower limits and the interaction lower limit pass. Otherwise keep the drug mean as a nonpersonalized rank reference.

three_dimensional.local_labels: Patient-blocked local labels on the same declared K recipients, for all supervised arms. Yang P1 and P2 excluded. Pre-treatment RNA only. Patient-level mean over regional PDO samples.
three_dimensional.shrinkage: Fit a nonnegative affine transform of the 2D drug means to local K drug means and estimate empirical-Bayes prior strength from between-drug signal and pooled within-drug noise, using local K only. Estimate gamma by nonnegative least squares on treatment responses and score residuals centered on the local reference drug means.
three_dimensional.gate: Require positive paired lower 95% limits for d minus c on within-patient NDCG and interaction Spearman while outperforming the pure local K mean under paired comparison. Treat isolated results as descriptive and do not claim field utility without new experiment.
three_dimensional.transfer: Use identical compound identities and patient aggregation across cohorts. Keep Sorafenib-only correlations separate from common 3-drug rankings.
three_dimensional.support: Compare all arms on exact matches to the frozen 68-compound registry. For the Yang five-drug secondary panel, allow local calibrated b/c/d arms and use the same local mean and zero transported residual for unsupported compounds. Use V0+ v2's fixed offline missing-cell-embedding path in all PDO studies. Center the residual by calibration compound means and the current sample mean on the supported drug panel.
